regressor: clean speech <Title> unless noted; babble_mixture: mixture <Title>_L<SNR> as played

backward.method: LOTO ridge backward decoder, lags 0-250 ms, lambda 0.1 x mean eigenvalue, 64 Hz, 0.5-8 Hz, avg ref; nulls: 50 circular shifts (>= 5 s) and up to 20 mismatched envelopes per held-out trial (null of the subject mean: 2000 draws of one null value per trial; population: mean of the subject nulls); lag sweep +-1 s in 1-sample (15.6 ms) steps, peak by parabolic interpolation, 95% CI by subject bootstrap

latency_trf_fc.method: forward TRF clean envelope, 128 Hz, 1-15 Hz, FC mean (Fz Cz F3 F4 C3 C4), avg ref; P1 = max 20-90 ms, N1 = min 70-200 ms

weissbart2019_same_method_16ch.note: weissbart2019 standardised (stimtrack-aligned), restricted to herrmann2025's 16 scalp channels, average reference over them; same backward model / latency TRF code
